suggestions.point: The 'image_text_auditor' expert was excluded from the plan despite the presence of label text. While the Router noted low resolution, this expert is specifically designed to detect 'unreadable text artifacts' and 'gibberish', which is a critical failure mode for AI-generated product packaging. Relying solely on the perceptual auditor for text structure is less rigorous than using the dedicated OCR-pipeline expert to confirm the absence of valid character structures.

The 'fine_grained_classifier' is targeted only at the rightmost bottle. To ensure robust class verification, it should ideally sample all three distinct container types (pump, frosted, aerosol) to confirm they all fall within the 'hair care/personal care' taxonomy, as the leftmost pump bottle is structurally different from a standard aerosol can.
